items.headline: Washington QB Williams unlikely to return vs. Purdue
items.description: Washington quarterback Demond Williams Jr. seems unlikely to return this week from a rib injury he suffered during the Huskies' loss to Iowa Friday, but coach Jedd Fisch said Monday that "we still have four days before we'll have to make that decision."

items.headline: Kamari Moulton runs for career-best 208 yards and 2 TDs as No. 20 Iowa beats Washington, 41-24
items.description: — Kamari Moulton ran for a career-high 208 yards on 26 carries and the Iowa defense held Washington to minus-3 yards rushing as the 20th-ranked Hawkeyes rolled to a 41-24 victory Friday night.
